# github-release.yml

<link-summary>Inputs, secrets and outputs of the reusable workflow GitHub release.</link-summary>

```text
Creates or completes the GitHub release of a tag: release notes (Inspectra changelog notes, the
CHANGELOG.md section, a file or GitHub's generated notes), every release-assets-* artifact of the
run (native binaries, app builds), a checksums.txt over them and build provenance attestations.

The caller grants contents: write, and id-token: write with attestations: write for the
attestations.
```

```yaml
jobs:
  github-release:
    uses: davils-com/workflows/.github/workflows/github-release.yml@v1
```

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `working-directory` | string | `.` | Directory of the root pubspec.yaml, relative to the repository root. |
| `tag` | string | empty | The release tag; empty takes github.ref_name. |
| `package` | string | empty | Name of the released package, for the release name. |
| `package-path` | string | `.` | Directory of the released package, relative to the working directory, for the release notes. |
| `version` | string | empty | The released version; empty reads it from the tag (the part after the last v). |
| `name` | string | empty | Release name; {package}, {version} and {tag} are replaced. Empty names it "{package} {version}" in a workspace and "{version}" otherwise. |
| `notes-source` | string | `auto` | auto (inspectra when the package has an Inspectra configuration, else the CHANGELOG.md section, else generated), inspectra, changelog, file, generate or keep (the body of an existing release, such as one of release-please). |
| `notes-file` | string | empty | For notes-source file, the path relative to the working directory. |
| `has-inspectra` | boolean | `false` | true when the package has an Inspectra configuration (pipeline.yml passes it). |
| `inspectra-install` | string | `auto` | How Inspectra is installed for notes-source inspectra (auto, dev-dependency, global, binary). |
| `assets-enabled` | boolean | `true` | Attach the release-assets-* artifacts of the run. |
| `assets-pattern` | string | `release-assets-*` | Pattern of the artifacts to attach. |
| `checksums` | boolean | `true` | Attach a checksums.txt with the SHA-256 of every asset. |
| `attest` | boolean | `true` | Attest the build provenance of every asset. |
| `prerelease` | string | `auto` | auto (when the version has a pre-release part), true or false. |
| `make-latest` | string | `auto` | auto, true or false. auto marks it as latest unless it is a pre-release or a package release of a workspace other than latest-package. |
| `latest-package` | string | empty | In a workspace, the package whose releases become the latest release. |
| `draft` | boolean | `false` | Create the release as a draft. |
| `mode` | string | `auto` | auto (complete an existing release, create one otherwise), create, update or skip. |
| `sdk` | string | `stable` | Dart SDK for the Inspectra notes. |
| `runners` | string | `{}` | JSON object of runner labels. |
| `timeout-minutes` | number | `20` | Timeout of the job. |
| `harden-runner` | boolean | `true` | Run step-security/harden-runner first. |
| `harden-runner-egress-policy` | string | `audit` | audit or block. |
| `harden-runner-allowed-endpoints` | string | empty | Endpoints allowed with the block policy, space separated. |

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `url` | URL of the release. |

## Permissions the caller grants

- `attestations: write`
- `contents: write`
- `id-token: write`
